references.text: Both events involve a blind person crying out to Jesus, "Son of David, have mercy on me!" even though people try to silence them.
Similar to Mark 10:48, where a blind beggar cries out to Jesus for mercy, and people try to get him to be quiet, but he cries out all the more loudly.
The prophecy that the Messiah will open the eyes of the blind, which is fulfilled in the events described in Mark 10:48.
David's prayer for God's mercy, which is mirrored in the blind man's cry to "Son of David" in Mark 10:48.
